blocks.text: Grammy Award-winning singer, songwriter, and producer Zach Bryan returns with the new EP Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs, this Friday, October 16, via Warner Records. Bryan has teased new songs throughout the summer and now the much anticipated eight-song set marks Bryan’s first new music since his chart-topping January 2026 album With Heaven On Top and its stripped-down counterpart, With Heaven On Top (Acoustic), which arrived three days later. Led by the Lana Del Rey duet “Lies,” Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs highlights Bryan’s ever-evolving maturation — and unpredictability — as an artist in real time. The EP also […]...
